meta.title: NK Hostel, Taipei | Rooms by Nanjing Sanmin MRT, Songshan
meta.description: On Nanjing East Road in Songshan, Taipei, a walk from Raohe Night Market and Nanjing Sanmin MRT. Double rooms, four- and six-person rooms and capsules, with the best rates when you book direct.

home.taglineEn: Travel is an extension of life.
home.intro: On the fifth floor of Nanjing East Road, we keep a light on for you. Spend the day out in the city, and come back at night to a room that feels like home.
home.heroAlt: Deluxe Room: leather headboard, wall lamps and full-length sheer curtains
home.heroCaption: The Deluxe Room in the three o'clock light
home.storyLead: A home, even while you travel.
home.storyBody1: We believe travel is an extension of life, a way of meeting the world. What we want to share is more than a place to sleep.
home.storyBody2: Every piece of furniture and every towel was chosen the way you would choose for your own family, and every corner was arranged with care, because a comfortable, relaxed space brings people a little closer.
home.storyBody3: Come and help us finish this warm corner of Taipei.
home.storyPhotoAlt: 8th-floor lounge: red brick walls, a blue sofa and tall windows
home.facilitiesBody: The 5th floor has a 24-hour front desk, the NK BAR and a shared kitchen; the 8th floor has a lounge and self-service laundry; the 14th-floor roof terrace looks out to Taipei 101.
home.reviewsBody: Thank you to everyone who has stayed with us. These scores are yours.
home.locationBody: About 8 minutes' walk from exit 4 of Nanjing Sanmin MRT station, with a bus stop right outside. Raohe Street Night Market and Songshan Station are within walking distance, and Songshan Airport is about 10 minutes by taxi.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Eight room types at NK Hostel: capsule beds, rooms for four and six, Mini, Classic and Deluxe double rooms, and a connecting room for four. Photos, beds, sizes and in-room amenities.
rooms.intro: From a capsule for one to a connecting room for a family or a group of friends, every bed is made up with 350-thread-count combed cotton.
rooms.guestsValue: Up to {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}
rooms.priceNote: Prices vary with dates and number of guests

pages.facilitiesDescription: Shared spaces at NK Hostel: 24-hour front desk, NK BAR, shared kitchen and terrace on 5F, lounge and self-service laundry on 8F, and a roof terrace on 14F.
pages.locationDescription: How to reach NK Hostel: 8 minutes' walk from Nanjing Sanmin MRT, plus buses, trains, high-speed rail, Taoyuan and Songshan airports, airport transfers and parking.
pages.attractionsDescription: Near NK Hostel: Raohe Street Night Market, Songshan Ciyou Temple, Rainbow Riverside Park, Taipei Arena, Taipei 101 and Elephant Mountain.
pages.groupsDescription: Group stays for school trips, sports teams and staff training, plus half-month and monthly long stays. Send us the form and we will reply as soon as we can.
pages.privacyDescription: How NK Hostel collects, uses and protects your personal data.
pages.termsDescription: NK Hostel direct booking terms: payment, cancellation and refunds.

bookingStatus.title: Your booking
bookingStatus.slow: We haven't heard from the bank about your payment yet. If you paid, your confirmation email will follow; you can also check under Manage booking.
bookingStatus.failed: The payment didn't go through and nothing was charged. Your room is still held, so you can try again.
bookingStatus.retryGone: This payment can't be restarted from here: the hold has lapsed or this browser no longer has the booking. Search again to book.
bookingStatus.paidPending: Payment received. We're confirming your room, and the confirmation will go to {email}.
bookingStatus.confirmedBody: We've emailed the details to {email}. See you in Taipei.
bookingStatus.refunded: The room couldn't be confirmed after your payment, so the full amount has been refunded. The details are in your email.
bookingStatus.expired: The hold ran out before payment arrived, and nothing was charged. Search again to book.
bookingStatus.needEmail: Enter the email you booked with to see this booking.
bookingStatus.notFound: No booking matches that code and email.
bookingStatus.rateLimited: Too many lookups. Wait a minute, then try again.

manage.title: Manage booking
manage.description: Look up or cancel a booking made on the NK Hostel website with your booking code and email.
manage.intro: Enter the booking code from your confirmation email and the email you booked with.
manage.refundPreview: If you cancel now, {amount} will be refunded.
manage.noRefund: Under your rate's cancellation rules, cancelling now is not refunded.
manage.cancelledRefund: Your booking is cancelled. {amount} is being refunded to your card; banks usually take 7 to 14 working days to show it.
manage.frontDeskRefund: The remaining {amount} was paid at the front desk and will be returned by the front desk; please contact the hotel.
manage.inProgress: A cancellation of this booking is already in progress. Check back in a few minutes.
manage.notCancellable: This booking can't be cancelled online while it is: {status}.
manage.refundFailed: The refund couldn't be completed automatically, so the booking isn't cancelled yet. Our front desk has been alerted and will email you.
manage.onlineOnlyConfirmed: Only confirmed bookings can be cancelled online.
manage.pastCheckIn: This booking can no longer be cancelled online after the check-in day. Please contact the front desk.
manage.changePending: A change to this booking is still being processed, so it can't be cancelled online right now. Please contact the hotel.
manage.error: That didn't work. Please try again shortly.
